raw_segments.text: He shall to Parthia. Be it art or hap, he hath spoken true. The very dice obey him,
and in our sports my better cunning faints under his chance. If we draw lots, he speeds.
His cocks do win the battle still of mine when it is all to naught, and his quails ever
beat mine in hooped at odds. I will to Egypt. And though I make this marriage for my peace,
I th east my pleasure lies.
